description: Monthly Basic Allowance for Housing from the 2026 RC/Transient baseline rate table by pay grade, with or without dependents, plus the annualized amount. This is the single national baseline rate; it does not vary by duty station or ZIP code. Use when the user needs a Basic Allowance for Housing baseline rate by pay grade and dependency status. For total monthly military pay use calculate_military_pay. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive BAH calculator.

dependents.description: Whether the rate is with or without dependents.

pay_grade.description: Pay grade, e.g. E-5 or O-3. O-7+ covers O-7 to O-10.

name: calculate_bah

calculator_url.description: Deep link to the matching interactive calculator on everycalc.xyz.

inputs.description: The normalized inputs the calculation used.

results.description: The computed figures for this calculator.

tool.description: Name of the tool that ran.
